subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Should maintainers keep this branch as the canonical Google Chat app-auth media fallback candidate after rebase and repair, or switch to the overlapping member PR once it is refreshed?
rationale: The same bug has overlapping candidate work, this branch conflicts with current main, and the remaining blockers include both contributor proof and security/message-delivery boundary choices.

options.title: Repair this branch before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open, require a narrow upload-scope predicate, preserved action metadata, conflict refresh, and inspectable app-auth proof before final review.

options.title: Use the member candidate after refresh
options.body: Pause or close this PR only if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 becomes mergeable, proof-accepted, and covers the same three delivery paths.

options.title: Waive live proof deliberately
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept source-level proof, but the predicate, metadata, and conflict blockers still need repair.

recommendation.title: Repair this branch before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, require a narrow upload-scope predicate, preserved action metadata, conflict refresh, and inspectable app-auth proof before final review.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest Google Chat runtime/action history and is the best available routing owner for the canonical-fix choice.
